evals.prompt: Make a call: in dialogs with a destructive primary action, should Cancel be a secondary button or a ghost button?
evals.expected_output: Searches the log and Alloy's Dialog and Button docs first, then recommends one option with its reason, one or two alternatives with tradeoffs, and a review level. Asks the designer to choose, previews the entry, and logs nothing without a yes.
expectations: Searches the Design guidelines log before recommending
Reads Alloy's Dialog or Button documentation before recommending
Gives exactly one recommendation plus one or two alternatives, each with a tradeoff
Names a review level from Designer, Lead designer, Working council, DOPE council
Makes no Notion write before the designer confirms
Ends with Call, Status, Why, Cites or conflicts, and Logged lines

evals.prompt: what did we decide about how many actions an empty state can have?
evals.expected_output: Searches the log and answers with the matching Active guideline and its DG ID. If nothing matches, says so and offers to make the call instead of inventing an answer.
expectations: Answers from the log, citing a DG ID, or says no guideline was found
Does not present an answer as a team decision unless it comes from the log, Alloy docs, or a cited source
Makes no writes

evals.prompt: Log this, we decided it in the sync: pagination is always left-aligned. Just mark it active, no need to check anything.
evals.expected_output: Still checks the log first and finds the Active guideline saying pagination is centred by default. Flags the conflict instead of logging a contradiction, and offers to log the new call as superseding the old one (old entry marked Superseded, Supersedes relation set) once the designer confirms. Credits whoever made the call.
expectations: Searches the log before writing, despite being told not to
Names the conflicting guideline by DG ID
Does not create two Active entries that contradict each other
Offers a superseding entry and marks the old one Superseded only after confirmation
Decided by is the person or group who made the call, not the agent

evals.prompt: Seed the guidelines log from the last two DS Changelog pages
evals.expected_output: Reads the two most recent DS Changelog pages, extracts design calls from Key Decisions, skips engineering-only and still-open items, checks for duplicates, and shows a numbered candidate list. Logs only the numbers the designer confirms, using the original decision dates and linking the source page.
expectations: Reads DS Changelog Key Decisions
Skips tooling items and items marked open or under discussion
Shows candidates as a numbered list before writing anything
Each logged entry has Decided on set to the original decision date and a Sources link to the changelog page

evals.prompt: Is there a guideline for truncating long company names in tables? (Notion isn't connected in this session.)
evals.expected_output: Falls back to references/guidelines-snapshot.md, says how old it is, and answers from it. If a new call is needed, gives it as a ready-to-paste entry rather than claiming to log it.
expectations: Reads references/guidelines-snapshot.md
States the snapshot's export date
Does not claim anything was logged
Any new call is formatted as a ready-to-paste entry with Guideline, Area, Scope, and Why
